run_TSInteractiveModel: run a PyTorch Lightning module that orchestrates teacher-student interactive reasoning conversations with async batching
run_ts_interaction: run an async tree search interaction between teacher and student models with configurable expansion size
run_batch_ts_interaction: run batched async teacher-student interactions with progress tracking and JSONL output saving
run_save_to_jsonl: run a thread-safe function to save a list of dictionaries to a JSONL file in write or append mode
run_validation_step: run a validation step that processes batches of init prompts through the teacher-student interactive model
